newsitem.title: USA: Hawk Marine sets split, plans new business.
newsitem.headline: Hawk Marine sets split, plans new business.

text.p: Hawk Marine Power Inc said late on Monday that it plans to enter entirely new businesses in an effort to become profitable, a venture it says is high risk and may have a remote chance of success.
The company, which currently is engaged in high performance engine manufacturing, said it also has set a 1-for-80 reverse stock split to recapitalise.
"The company has been unprofitable for the last few years and has limited capital to continue active business operations," President Craig Barrie said in a statement.

The company said it is considering entering the business of licensing, designing and marketing of merchandise and apparel. It has hired management to assist in such a project, and to attempt to raise capital through the issue of debt or equity instruments to fund future operations.

Under the reverse stock split shareholders will receive one share of the company's common stock for every 80 shares held. No fractional shares are to be issued and any fractional interests are to be rounded to the nearest whole number, it said.
